description: Search, filter, and analyze the Y Combinator startup directory from a local cache.

tools.name: batches_get
tools.description: Fetch every company in a YC batch. Required: batch_slug. Returns array of Company.

tools.name: companies_black_founded
tools.description: Fetch Black-founded YC companies. Returns array of Company.

tools.name: companies_get_in_batch
tools.description: Fetch a single company by batch slug and company slug. Required: batch_slug, slug. Returns the Company.

tools.name: companies_hiring
tools.description: Fetch companies currently hiring. Returns array of Company.

tools.name: companies_hispanic_latino_founded
tools.description: Fetch Hispanic/Latino-founded YC companies. Returns array of Company.

tools.name: companies_list
tools.description: Fetch the full directory (5,889+ companies). Returns array of Company.

tools.name: companies_nonprofit
tools.description: Fetch nonprofit YC companies. Returns array of Company.

tools.name: companies_top
tools.description: Fetch top-ranked YC companies. Returns array of Company.

tools.name: companies_women_founded
tools.description: Fetch women-founded YC companies. Returns array of Company.

tools.name: industries_get
tools.description: Fetch every company in an industry. Required: industry_slug. Returns array of Company.

tools.name: meta_get
tools.description: Counts and last-updated timestamp for the directory. Returns the Meta.

tools.name: tags_get
tools.description: Fetch every company with a given tag. Required: tag_slug. Returns array of Company.
